messages:
ana_sales: Quick: Prospect (MetroBank) wants a 10-day air-gapped POC. Must-haves: verifiable SBOM + bundle provenance PDF, option for customer re-signing with their HSM, an offline activation token flow (no outbound call), and a fixed monthly price for an 8-GPU reserved offline pool. Also asked how rollbacks work for USB-only installs. Can we confirm deliverables + PS estimate?

diego_se: We can hand off a versioned bundle: bundle-v1.tar.gz + bundle-v1.sig + bundle_manifest.json. We'll also generate a short "handoff.pdf" containing build id, commit, SBOM digest, and a signed attest statement. If MetroBank wants to re-sign inside their perimeter, no integration work on our side.

ana_sales: They explicitly want a time-limited signing cert template so they can sign and prove freshness. Is that doable?

sree_ops: We can emit a short-lived signing cert (PEM) with a corresponding attestation block in the handoff PDF. To orchestrate signing ourselves against their Thales HSM (i.e., Redwood calling their HSM), that's a PS job: estimate 3 engineering days + 2 ops days for secure proxy + test harness. If they re-sign locally, PS=0.

mira_sec: MetroBank requires FIPS-validated signing and an auditable event log. For the questionnaire we should offer three modes: (A) customer re-signs (recommended), (B) Redwood integrates to sign into customer's HSM (audited), (C) vendor signs and we provide signed attestation. I'll draft the language.

diego_se: For USB/sneakernet installs we support chunked archives with an index file for resume (chunk_000..chunk_N + index.json). We provide a small reassembly/verify utility that: 1) validates per-chunk sha256, 2) reassembles tar, 3) validates top-level signature. Example verify snippet to give them:

```
# validate chunks and assemble
./verify_and_assemble.sh --index index.json --chunks ./usb
cosign verify --key redwood_vendor.pub bundle-v1.tar.gz.sig
```

We can include a GitHub Action snippet for CI to run the same checks if they mirror the bundle.

ana_sales: What about rollback? They worry USB transfer may be corrupted mid-rollout.

sree_ops: Rollback strategy: keep previous bundle tarballs on the target host (we recommend last 2). Reassembly is atomic: verify -> stage -> swap. If swap fails, we roll back to previous bundle. We'll document the exact commands and a post-install smoke-test they can run. Maintenance windows: small patches 20-60m; major rollouts 2-5h depending on copy speed and manual steps.

mira_sec: Activation token flow: we offer an offline activation file (activation.jwt signed by Redwood). If they prefer, we can produce an activation package they re-sign with their HSM. If MetroBank wants Redwood to sign activation tokens using their HSM, add PS.

ana_sales: Pricing: they asked for firm monthly for 8-GPU offline reserved pool + 24/7 offline incident support for POC month. Any ballpark?

diego_se: Ballpark numbers over DM. For proposal include: base reserved pool price, offline-support uplift, and a one-time PS line for HSM proxy if needed.

deploy-bot: Ticket SLS-33221 created: "MetroBank air-gapped POC : handoff attestation, chunked USB, activation tokens" by ana_sales.

mira_sec: I'll produce the questionnaire answers and FIPS wording.

sree_ops: I'll prepare a 2-page runbook excerpt (verify scripts, chunk table, rollback steps, smoke tests) by EOD Monday.

diego_se: I'll produce the verify_and_assemble.sh, CI snippet, and a sample handoff.pdf template by Monday.

ana_sales: Great — aim to send a single package to MetroBank Tues AM. Thanks team :thumbsup:
